title: Qonductor: A Cloud Orchestrator for Quantum Computing
problem: Hybrid quantum-classical applications face challenges in resource management and job scheduling across heterogeneous hybrid resources, with no unified abstraction for programming and orchestration.
motivation: Practical quantum-classical workflows require automated resource balancing, mitigation of hardware noise effects, and optimization of user QoS and cloud operator resource efficiency.
method: Qonductor cloud orchestrator with high-level hardware-agnostic API, resource estimator for quantum-classical balancing, and hybrid scheduler optimizing QoS/efficiency trade-offs across quantum and classical resources.
key_novelty: First cloud orchestrator specifically designed for hybrid quantum-classical workloads with resource estimation and intelligent scheduling across heterogeneous hybrid resources.
contributions: Qonductor API: high-level hardware-agnostic programming interface
Resource estimator: strategic quantum-classical resource balancing
Hybrid scheduler: automated job scheduling optimizing QoS and efficiency
54% lower job completion times (JCTs) vs. baseline
66% increase in quantum resource utilization via load balancing
Scalability with growing system sizes and workloads
Evaluation on 7000+ real quantum runs from IBM cloud
limitations: Evaluation limited to IBM quantum cloud; specific mitigation strategies for hardware noise not detailed; scalability beyond current hybrid sizes unclear.
